title: demo-cli
description: A sample CLI tool for demonstration purposes.

sections.readme:
# demo-cli

A fast CLI tool built with Go and Cobra.

![Build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-passing-green)
sections.installation:
## Installation

```bash
go install github.com/yusukensanta/demo-cli@latest
```

Or download a binary from the [releases page](https://github.com/yusukensanta/demo-cli/releases).
sections.contributing:
## Contributing

1. Fork the repo
2. Create a feature branch: `git checkout -b feat/my-feature`
3. Commit your changes
4. Open a pull request

Please run `go test ./...` before opening a PR.

## コントリビュート

1. リポジトリをフォークする
2. フィーチャーブランチを作成する: `git checkout -b feat/my-feature`
3. 変更をコミットする
